test.title: A habit your family has that you like

document.cue: Describe a habit your family has that you like.

text: The habit I'd like to talk about is our Sunday lunch. Every Sunday, no matter how busy everyone is, the whole family gets together at my grandparents' flat in Astana and has a long meal that usually lasts about three hours.

As far as I know, it started when my parents got married and my grandmother insisted that they visit at least once a week. Since then, it's grown from four people to about twelve, including my cousins and, recently, my aunt's new husband, who still looks a bit overwhelmed by all the noise.

Everyone has a role. My grandmother makes beshbarmak, my uncle is in charge of the tea, and the children set the table. There's one strict rule: phones go into a basket by the door. At first my younger cousins complained a lot, but now they're the ones reminding the adults.

I like it because it's the only time in the week when three generations actually talk to each other properly. We argue about politics, catch up on news and plan birthdays. Even when I was at my busiest during exams, those few hours made me feel calmer and more connected.
So although it takes up most of the day, I'd never want to give it up.

tips.en: Everyone has a role gives specific details instead of just saying the family meets.
tips.kk: Everyone has a role — жалпы «жиналамыз» деудің орнына нақты дерек.
tips.ru: Everyone has a role — конкретика вместо общего «мы собираемся».

tips.en: Now they're the ones reminding the adults shows an unexpected result of the rule.
tips.kk: Now they're the ones reminding the adults — ереженің күтпеген нәтижесі.
tips.ru: Now they're the ones reminding the adults — неожиданный итог правила.
tips.example: now they're the ones reminding the adults

note.en: “Even when people have a lot to do”.
What the habit is — straight away, with the place and how long it lasts.
note.kk: Қандай әдет — бірден, орны мен ұзақтығымен.
note.ru: Что за привычка — сразу, с местом и длительностью.

note.en: How it began and grew — with a joke about a new relative.
note.kk: Қалай пайда болды және қалай өсті — жаңа туыс туралы әзілмен.
note.ru: Как появилась и как выросла — с шуткой про нового родственника.

note.en: Who takes part — the roles and the rule about phones.
note.kk: Кім қатысады — рөлдер және телефон туралы ереже.
note.ru: Кто участвует — роли и правило про телефоны.

note.en: Why it matters — three generations and calm during a stressful time.
note.kk: Неге ұнайды — үш буын және қиын кездегі тыныштық.
note.ru: Почему нравится — три поколения и спокойствие в трудный период.

note.en: A short ending with a firm position.
